Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the run chase. The umpires have made their way out to the middle followed by the Bangladesh players who take their positions on the field. Muhammad Waseem and Chirag Suri will open the innings for United Arab Emirates and will be looking to get off to a good start. Mohammad Saifuddin has been handed the new ball and he will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Bangladesh should be able to get over the finish line by defending this total but will still have to come out looking for early wickets. They will do well to not take this game lightly as the hosts have proved they have decent batting ability. United Arab Emirates need to get off to a good start and will be counting on their top-order to make most of the runs. Will they be able to pull off an unlikely win? Or will the visitors clinch this series with ease? We will find out soon. Do join us shorty for the run chase.

Bangladesh got off to a tentative start and lost Sabbir Rahman early to the spin of Aryan Lakra. Litton Das combined with Mehidy Hasan to take the attack to the United Arab Emirates bowlers and began scoring freely. Aayan Khan once again showed why he is so highly regarded, as he broke the 41-run partnership and claimed the wicket of the dangerous-looking Afif Hossain soon after. Mehidy Hasan departed 4 runs short of his half-century to a poor decision from the umpire and the hosts started clawing back into the game. Mosaddek Hossain, Yasir Ali, and Nurul Hasan played useful cameos to push the total close to the 170-run mark. The death bowlers for United Arab Emirates did an outstanding job to not allow Bangladesh to run away with it. The spinners also did a good job as Aayan Khan took two wickets with Karthik Meiyappan and Aryan Lakra picking up one wicket each.

What outstanding death bowling from the hosts except for the last ball! They have done well to shackle the scoring towards the end. Bangladesh will be quite content with the total of 169 runs on the board but would have loved to have a few more runs with the start they had. They will be pretty confident in defending this target on a pitch that has not been completely helpful to the batters. Most of them got off to good starts but could not make the most of it. The hosts have bowled well towards the end, to pull the game back a bit but will need to put on an outstanding performance with the bat to be able to breach this target.

SIX! Nurul Hasan finally gets his timing right and powers this over long off! This was a such a good over so far but this hit has made it a 14-run over now. A full delivery on off. This time he misses his yorker and Hasan finally gets under it and launches it over long off for a maximum. Bangladesh finish with 169/5 after 20 overs!

Misses out on a full toss! Ali makes room and Khan follows him. He bowls a full toss and Ali tries to hit it towards extra cover. He just gets an edge and the ball rolls towards the left of keeper. The batters steal a run as the keeper throws it back to the bowler.
Superb yorker, around off. Nurul Hasan stays deep in his crease but does not get under it and only manages another single to long off.
Again, not able to find boundaries! Just a single as Ali slogs it without much timing to long on for a single.
Bowls it very full and on middle. Hasan drills it to long on for a single.

FOUR! That's a lucky start to the over for Bangladesh! Short and outside off. It is a slower delivery and Nurul Hasan gets across and tries to drag it towards the leg side. He gets a top edge and the ball goes over the keeper and runs away towards the fence.
Yes, he does! Absolutely top-notch over! Nails a yorker on off. All Nurul Hasan manages to do is to dig it out to long on for a single. Can Bangladesh get a big final over?
This is brilliant death bowling! A yorker on off. Ali digs it out to covers for a single. Can Zawar Farid finish this over well now?
Nails a wide yorker as Farid follows Nurul Hasan who moves across to his right. Hasan only manages to hit it to long off for a single.
Just a single again! A slower full delivery on off. Ali slogs it without much timing to long on for a single. Very good over so far.
A low full toss on off. Hasan hits it to long on for a single.
Bowls it full and outside off. Hasan goes far across outside off stump and drills it straight down the ground. It is two more runs for Bangladesh!

SIX! Zahoor Khan gets a bit predictable this time and gets thumped for a maximum! A slower short ball, around off. Yasir Ali stays deep in his crease waiting for this short slower delivery and pulls it aerially and just over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
This is really clever bowling! Zahoor Khan bangs it short and outside off. It is an off-pace delivery and Ali is way too early in his shot, misses it completely.
Khan drags his length back, on off. Ali pulls it to right of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A slower delivery that is way down the leg side. Nurul Hasan tries to paddle it and gets just some part of his blade. The ball rolls towards the keeper and a single is taken.
Bowls it short and on off. Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Zahoor Khan begins with a full delivery straying on the pads, Yasir Ali clips this to mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Nurul Hasan the skipper of Bangladesh strides out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mosaddek Hossain holes out in the deep! This has been a good fightback by United Arab Emirates! Karthik Meiyappan tosses this up again, on off. Mosaddek Hossain goes for the big slog sweep and hits it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. Muhammad Waseem moves to his left there and takes the catch safely. Bangladesh lose their fifth wicket and Karthik Meiyappan truly deserves this wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Waseem b Karthik Meiyappan

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads again. Ali this time flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Mosaddek Hossain clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

A tough chance but it could have been taken. This is a loopy delivery, around off. Mosaddek Hossain goes for the reverse sweep and gets a big top edge. The ball goes behind the short third man fielder. The man there runs back and tries to catch it but misjudges it completely. Two taken.
Tossed up, around off. Ali goes for a big heave across the line. He, however, gets an inside edge that goes towards short fine leg. Another single.
Bowls a googly that pitches on middle. Mosaddek Hossain gets across to his right and clips it to short fine leg for a single.
Just a single to end the over! Back of a length and on middle. It is an off-pace delivery as well and Mosaddek Hossain pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Can Bangladesh reach 170 from here?
Angles it into middle and leg. Ali clips it to fine leg for a single.
On the shorter side and around off. Mosaddek Hossain steers it towards third man for a single.
Dot ball! Mosaddek Hossain dances down the track and Khan bowls it slower and drags his length back as well. Mosaddek Hossain tries to pull it but gets the inside edge back to the keeper.
Good short slower ball, on middle. Ali pull it without much timing to the left of short fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Mosaddek Hossain works it to square leg for a single.

FOUR! Yasir Ali gets off the mark with a cracking shot! Sabir Ali serves a short ball to welcome the new batter to the crease. Yasir Ali gets on top of this and pulls this towards deep backward square leg to start his inning with four runs. 13 runs and one wicket from this over.
Yasir Ali walks out to the middle now.

OUT! LBW! This is a dicey decision from the umpire! However, without DRS, the decision stays! Sabir Ali serves this on a good length and the ball is pitching outside the line of the leg stump. Mehidy Hasan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The ball seems to be clearly pitching beyond the leg stump and Mehidy Hasan looks stunned by the decision. Sadly, he has to make the long walk back after playing a really good inning. United Arab Emirates will not complain as they have dismissed the set batter and have now claimed four wickets.

FOUR! This has been slapped away! Sabir Ali bowls this slightly short as well and outside off, Mehidy Hasan swings hard at the ball and gets bat on the ball. Does not hit this off the middle of the bat but the ball flies over the infield towards the deep backward point boundary for four more runs.
This is back of a length and wide outside off, Mehidy Hasan slashes hard at this but is beaten all ends up.

FOUR! Mehidy Hasan playing some unorthodox shorts here but it is proving to be effective! This is on a good length and just outside off, Mehidy Hasan steps across to the off side and paddles the ball to the left of the keeper for a boundary to straightish fine leg.
Sabir Ali bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Mosaddek Hossain clips this to deep square leg and takes one.
Sabir Ali is back on. Two overs for 23 runs so far.

Karthik Meiyappan loops this full and outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan goes for the sweep shot and misses. The wicket-keeper whips the bails off and appeals for a stumping. Replays show the foot was dragged out but Mehidy Hasan got it back immediately and he is safe.
Googly angled into the pads on a fuller length, Mosaddek Hossain plays this to long on and takes an easy single.

FOUR! Another reverse sweep and brings about the same result! Karthik Meiyappan bowls this outside off on a fuller length, Mosaddek Hossain goes across the stumps and reverse sweeps this into the deep point fence for four more runs.
Loopy delivery served outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan shimmies down the wicket and mistimes his short to long off for a run.
This is full as well and spinning into the pads, Mosaddek Hossain clips this to deep mid-wicket for a single to get off strike.

FOUR! Mosaddek Hossain is being innovative here! Karthik Meiyappan floats a full toss in line with the leg stumps, Mosaddek Hossain premeditates and reverse sweeps this towards third man for a boundary.
Another dot to end the over! A flatter delivery on off. Pushed quicker as well and Hasan cuts it to the point fielder.
This is flighted full as well and outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan strokes this straight to the cover fielder.
This is short and outside off, Mosaddek Hossain pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Charges down the wicket once again on a full delivery in line with the stumps. Hits this on the bounce to the fielder at long on and does not take a run.

SIX! Mosaddek Hossain is attacking the young bowler here! Another flighted delivery bowled just outside off, Mosaddek Hossain is down the wicket in a flash as he thumps this towards long on for a maximum.
Aayan Khan bowls this full and straight, Mosaddek Hossain blocks this to the left of the bowler.
This is a fraction short and a googly spinning into the stumps, Mosaddek Hossain tucks this through square leg and looks for two but has to settle for a single.
Continues to bowl on a fuller length outside the off pole, Mosaddek Hossain guides this to short third man.

Bowls a googly just outside off on a fuller length, Mosaddek Hossain gets his front foot outside the line of off stump and looks to block. Gets beaten and the ball hits his pads. There is a massive appeal but the umpire remains unmoved.
Flights this one full and just outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan charges down the wicket and mistimes his shot towards long on for one more run.
This is looped up and bowled on a yorker length in line with the stumps. Mosaddek Hossain digs this out to long on for a single.
Karthik Meiyappan flights this full and outside off, Mehidy Hasan knocks this to the left of cover and takes one.
This is tossed up full and outside the off pole, Mosaddek Hossain taps this towards point. Another wonderful over from Aayan Khan.
Fires it on middle. It is fuller as well and Hasan clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What an outstanding catch in the deep! Their catching let them down in the previous game but not this time. Aayan Khan bowls a loopy full toss outside off, Afif Hossain goes for flick towards the leg side but does not connect well. Karthik Meiyappan comes running in from deep square leg and takes a blinder diving forward. Afif Hossain has to depart and this is a big wicket for United Arab Emirates.
Commentary.Howout: c Karthik Meiyappan b Aayan Khan

Commentary.Commentary: This is fired on a yorker length outside off, Afif Hossain digs this out towards the off side.

SIX! This is been struck handsomely! This is floated full and outside off, Afif Hossain gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Afif Hossain is taking it from where he left off.
Aayan Khan bowls this full and outside off, Mehidy Hasan drags this towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.

DRINKS! This has been a much better batting performance from Bangladesh as they have set up a solid platform here to launch towards the end. They got off to a watchful start but have picked up the ante and will be looking to end with a flourish. United Arab Emirates bowlers have not found the same kind of penetration and will now need to bowl with discipline which may result in wickets. Loads to look forward to after the break.

FOUR! Afif Hossain finishes the over in style and it will be 11 from the over! Khan bowls it short and around leg. Afif Hossain moves across to his left and just pulls it towards the fine leg region. The ball falls just short of the fence and crosses over.
Zahoor Khan continues to bowl it on the shorter side, on middle. Mehidy Hasan pulls it bit aerially and towards backward square leg for a single.
Good fielding at mid-wicket from Aayan Khan! Back of a length, on off. Afif Hossain pulls it hard and left of mid-wicket, Aayan Khan dives and stops it. Single taken.
FOUR! This time he finds the middle of his blade! Lovely shot. This is on a length and outside off. Afif Hossain extends his arms as he punches it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Wait is the call! Back of a length again, outside off. Afif Hossain slaps it off the bottom of his blade to mid off.
In the air...but safe! Back of a length, on off. Hasan pulls it aerially without any timing and it falls short of the long off fielder who runs to his right and cuts it off. Single taken.
Zahoor Khan has been handed the ball now.
Dot to end a quality over from the youngman! This is fuller and on off. Afif Hossain drives it towards cover. A wicket and 7 runs from it!
Sensible cricket, nudges this flatter delivery on middle to the leg side for a single.
Fires it on middle. Afif Hossain clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on the pads. Afif Hossain sweeps it to fine leg and comes back for the second run. He is off the mark straightaway!
Afif Hossain the half-centurion from the last game makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Litton Das departs and Aayan Khan is rewarded for some clever bowling here. He has been changing his pace quite well along with the length and now gets the big fish. This is short and quicker on middle. Das makes room and cuts it. However, he does so aerially and ends up hitting it straight to Karthik Meiyappan at backward point. He makes no mistake and United Arab Emirates break this partnership that was looking quite dangerous.
Commentary.Howout: c Karthik Meiyappan b Aayan Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, that is clever bowling! Khan sees Mehidy Hasan charging down the track and pulls his length back, The pace is also slower and Hasan goes for a big heave across the line. He, however, gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs towards the third man region. Three taken.
Tossed up delivery on off. Hasan drives it to covers for a single.
Pushes it quicker on middle. Das clips it to mid on for a single.

FOUR! Oh, just over the fielder at deep mid-wicket! This is fuller and on off. Das sweeps it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep is some yards inside from the fence than he should have been and tries to catch it with a jump in the end. However, the ball goes over him and bounces just inside the fence and crosses over.
Pushes it quicker and flatter on off. Das cuts it but hits it straight to the point fielder.
Tad shorter and around off. Hasan cuts it to point for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Das tries to go big down the ground. However, he fails to get the timing required and ends up hitting aerially and just short of long off for a single.
Karthik Meiyappan has been brought into the attack.

Back of a length and on middle. Hasan clips it to mid-wicket and he comes back for the second run. Very good running! Bangladesh have suddenly picked up some pace here and they would be hoping to continue this momentum forward in the middle overs.
Back of a length and around off. Das punches it to covers for a single.

FOUR! Das is looking in mood here! This is short and on middle. He actually drags his length back seeing Das charging down the pitch. It does not make any difference as Das pulls it towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Serves a length delivery, around off. Hasan guides it to third man for a single.
Lands it on a length and angles it on middle and leg this time. Das flicks it to deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Well timed but straight to the fielder! Back of a length and outside off. Das punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Single to end the Powerplay. 48 runs coming from it and a wicket! This is on middle and fuller. Das clips it wide of mid on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot, this is what Bangladesh need! Short and wide, around off. Das uses the depth of the crease and lifts it over the cover fielder for a boundary.

Good running and good fielding as well from Zahoor Khan in the deep. This is on middle and slower through the air. Hasan sweeps and gets a top edge. The ball goes over short fine leg and runs towards the fence but Khan chases it and stops it with a silde near the fence. Three taken.
Shorter in length again and around off. Das cuts it right of the point fielder and sets off for a single. The fielder picks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single in the end.
Pushed quicker on middle this time. Das just nudges it towards the leg side.
Bowls it short and on middle. Das makes room and cuts it straight to the cover fielder.

FOUR! This has been delicately played! Another quicker delivery bowled full and straying onto the pads, Mehidy Hasan uses the pace and paddles this to the right of short fine leg fielder as the ball races away to the fence. 11 runs from the over and Bangladesh looking to build momentum now.
Full once again and angled into the batter, Litton Das flicks this to the right of mid-wicket and takes one.
Fires this one full and into the pads, Litton Das clips this towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! This has been picked up beautifully! Aayan Khan goes really full and in line with the stumps, Litton Das lofts this over the infield and hits this ball towards long on for a boundary. He is getting a move on here.
Aayan Khan bowls this full and turning away outside off, Mehidy Hasan sweeps this hard towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle. Das leans forward and drives it to mid off for a single.
Aayan Khan is into the attack now. This youngman has been very impressive. Let's see how he goes about his business today.
Floats this one full and on the pads, Litton Das clips this down to long on for a single and will keep strike. End of a successful over for United Arab Emirates.
This is bowled full and outside off, Litton Das finds the cover fielder with his shot.
Litton Das walks out to the middle now.

OUT! LBW! United Arab Emirates have drawn first blood, which should lift them up quite a bit! Aryan Lakra floats this one full and just outside off, gets the ball to keep its line. Sabbir Rahman gets a stride across to the off side and looks to paddle this fine but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The batter begins to walk towards the shed and Bangladesh have got off to a circumspect start in this game.
This is served full as well and outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan taps this towards backward point and takes a quick single.
Flights this one full and outside off, Mehidy Hasan gets across the stumps and sweeps this but finds the mid-wicket fielder once again.
Aryan Lakra starts the over with a short delivery outside off, Mehidy Hasan pulls this straight to mid-wicket.
Continues bowling outside off on a fuller length, this is thumped straight to the cover fielder.
This is on a good length and just outside the off pole, Sabbir Rahman defends this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Pulls his length back once again and delivers this outside off, Mehidy Hasan cuts this towards backward point and takes a run.
Goes full this time and outside the off pole, Sabbir Rahman strokes this to the left of mid off and takes a single.

SIX! Sabbir Rahman makes the most of the Free Hit as he dispatches this into the crowd! Sabir Ali bowls this a fraction short and just outside off, Sabbir Rahman gets a hold of this and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
NO BALL! Sabir Ali bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Mehidy Hasan works this to square leg for a single. He has overstepped and it will be a Free Hit.

FOUR! This has been swatted away! Sabir Ali bowls this on a good length but wide outside off, Mehidy Hasan charges down the wicket and hits this into the gap in the off side for a boundary to deep cover-point.
Bowls this one slightly short and angled into the stumps, Sabbir Rahman goes back in the crease and looks to cut it late. Gets beaten as the ball misses the off pole by a fraction.
Continues bowling full and outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan slog sweeps this to deep square leg for a run.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Mehidy Hasan knocks this towards cover.
This is floated full and in line with the stumps, Sabbir Rahman pushes at this and gets an inside edge to the left of short fine leg for another single.
Angles this into the pads on a fuller length, Mehidy Hasan tucks this to short fine leg for one.
Aryan Lakra begins with a full delivery flighted outside off, Mehidy Hasan blocks this to the left of the bowler.
Aryan Lakra to start from the other end.

FOUR! Streaky but Sabbir Rahman gets off with a boundary as well! Sabir Ali bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump, Sabbir Rahman looks to push this towards the off side but gets an inside edge that goes past the stumps towards fine leg for four runs. 9 runs have come from the over.
Continues bowling on a good length but well outside off, Sabir Ali leaves this one alone.
Bowls this one a good length as well and outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan taps this towards cover with soft hands and takes off for a single.
BEATEN! Sabir Ali bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in from middle. Mehidy Hasan looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge as the ball goes through to the keeper.
FOUR! Mehidy Hasan is off the mark in style! Sabir Ali offers width and bowls this on a fuller length, Mehidy Hasan tonks this uppishly towards deep cover-point for a boundary!
Sabir Ali begins with a fullish delivery in line with the stumps, Mehidy Hasan defends this back towards the bowler.
We are all set to begin! United Arab Emirates players are out there in the middle. Mehidy Hasan and Sabbir Rahman are the openers for Bangladesh. Sabir Ali to start with the ball. Here we go...

Nurul Hasan, the skipper of Bangladesh says that he has no problem in batting first wicket as the wicket will be good and he believes that the batters will do well. Mentions that it is a team games, collapses can happen. 160 to 170 will be good total. Informs there are two changes.

Chundangapoyil Rizwan, the skipper of United Arab Emirates says he will bowl first. Claims he is happy with the performance in the previous game but would have been happier with a win. Mentions that they did well in patches but there is scope for improvement and hopefully they can come back stronger.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Muhammad Waseem, Chirag Suri, Aryan Lakra, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Chundangapoyil Rizwan (C), Basil Hameed, Aayan Khan, Zawar Farid, Karthik Meiyappan, Sabir Ali, Zahoor Khan.
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mehidy Hasan, Sabbir Rahman, Litton Das, Afif Hossain, Yasir Ali, Mosaddek Hossain, Nurul Hasan (C) (WK), Nasum Ahmed, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed, Ebadot Hossain.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of United Arab Emirates. They have elected to BOWL first.

United Arab Emirates have shown great character against a Test-playing nation but failed to get over the line in the previous encounter. With the opponents facing a difficult period, this is a perfect opportunity for them to upset their much-fancied opponents and take that confidence into the group stages of the World Cup. They started the game well with both bat and ball but will be looking to finish better as they let go of the initiative on both occasions. They will definitely learn with experience and if they come into the game with better plans, there could most likely be an upset on the cards. Will they be able to clinch an unlikely win and level the series? Or will the visitors put on a better performance and justify the favorites tag? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.
